summary: The agent initially failed trying to use openpyxl's native pivot table API (TableDefinition), which requires many mandatory fields and is fragile. The existing sales-pivot-analysis skill warns against xlsxwriter pivots but not openpyxl pivots. This update adds openpyxl pivot API to the anti-patterns list, reinforces the pandas-compute-then-write-static-tables pattern as the universal fallback, and adds guidance for date-derived columns (duration, decade, weekday bucket, status flags) seen in this library circulation task.
